For Boolean alternatives/conjunctions, use `where any` or `where all`, indented atoms, and `end`. Unknown evidence is an unknown result, not automatically a request for clarification.

For arithmetic and optimization, write `@c constraint` with `var ?x int MIN MAX`, `require EXPRESSION`, `claim EXPRESSION`, optional `objective EXPRESSION` and `direction min|max`, and `task possible|prove|optimize`. NEVER use parentheses or commas as relation delimiters: write `parent ana bogdan`. `not parent ana bogdan` is explicit negative evidence, not absence of positive evidence. @mother_parent rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@father_parent rule
  when father ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@grandparent_rule rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandparent ?x ?z

@grandmother_rule rule

  when parent ?y ?z

@find_ancestors template
  description "Găsește strămoșii unei persoane prin regulile aprobate."
  cue "ascendență"
  cue "strămoși"
  params person
  yield answer
  body |
    @q query
      mode select
      select ?who
      where ancestor ?who $person
    @m recall
      query $q
    @r reason
      query $q
      memory $m
    @answer cnl
      result $r
      language ro

@check_arrival template
  description "Recuperează durata rutei și calculează sosirea într-o zi, în minute de la miezul nopții."
  cue "sosire"
  cue "ajung"
  params route start deadline
  yield answer
  body |
    @travel query
      select ?duration
      where duration $route ?duration
    @retrieve_duration solve
      query $travel
      output ?duration one
    @timing constraint
      var ?arrival int 0 1440
      require ?arrival == $start + $duration
      claim ?arrival <= $deadline
      task possible
      unit minute
    @feasibility solve
      constraint $timing
      output ?arrival one
    @answer cnl
      result $feasibility
      language ro

@mother_parent rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@father_parent rule
  when father ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@grandparent_rule rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandparent ?x ?z

@grandmother_rule rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandmother ?x ?z

@ancestor_base rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  then ancestor ?x ?y

@ancestor_recursive rule

  when ancestor ?y ?z
  then ancestor ?x ?z

@employment_general rule
  when employed_by ?x ?o
  then works_at ?x ?o

@find_ancestors template
  description "Găsește strămoșii unei persoane prin regulile aprobate."
  cue "ascendență"
  cue "strămoși"
  params person
  yield answer
  body |
    @q query
      mode select
      select ?who
      where ancestor ?who $person
    @m recall
      query $q
    @r reason
      query $q
      memory $m
    @answer cnl
      result $r
      language ro

@check_arrival template
  description "Recuperează durata rutei și calculează sosirea într-o zi, în minute de la miezul nopții."
  cue "sosire"
  cue "ajung"
  params route start deadline
  yield answer
  body |
    @travel query
      select ?duration
      where duration $route ?duration
    @retrieve_duration solve
      query $travel
      output ?duration one
    @timing constraint
      var ?arrival int 0 1440
      require ?arrival == $start + $duration
      claim ?arrival <= $deadline
      task possible
      unit minute
    @feasibility solve
      constraint $timing
      output ?arrival one
    @answer cnl
      result $feasibility
      language ro

  holds mother person_a_731_6 person_b_731_6
  valid timeless
  source synthetic
  retention normal

@kb fact
  holds parent person_b_731_6 person_c_731_6
  valid timeless
  source synthetic
  retention normal

@kw fact
  holds works_at person_a_731_6 org_a_731_6
  valid 2024-01-01 open
  source synthetic
  retention normal

@kp fact
  holds project_member person_a_731_6 project_731_6
  valid 2025-01-01 open
  source synthetic
  retention normal

@kd fact
  holds duration route_731_6 70
  valid timeless
  source synthetic
  retention normal

@mother_parent rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@father_parent rule
  when father ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@grandparent_rule rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandparent ?x ?z

@grandmother_rule rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandmother ?x ?z

@ancestor_base rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  then ancestor ?x ?y

@ancestor_recursive rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when ancestor ?y ?z
  then ancestor ?x ?z

@employment_general rule
  when employed_by ?x ?o
  then works_at ?x ?o

@find_ancestors template
  description "Găsește strămoșii unei persoane prin regulile aprobate."
  cue "ascendență"
  cue "strămoși"
  params person
  yield answer
  body |
    @q query
      mode select
      select ?who
      where ancestor ?who $person
    @m recall
      query $q
    @r reason
      query $q
      memory $m
    @answer cnl
      result $r
      language ro

@check_arrival template
  description "Recuperează durata rutei și calculează sosirea într-o zi, în minute de la miezul nopții."
  cue "sosire"
  cue "ajung"
  params route start deadline
  yield answer
  body |
    @travel query
      select ?duration
      where duration $route ?duration
    @retrieve_duration solve
      query $travel
      output ?duration one
    @timing constraint
      var ?arrival int 0 1440
      require ?arrival == $start + $duration
      claim ?arrival <= $deadline
      task possible
      unit minute
    @feasibility solve
      constraint $timing
      output ?arrival one
    @answer cnl
      result $feasibility
      language ro

  valid timeless

@kw fact
  holds works_at person_a_731_10 org_a_731_10
  valid 2024-01-01 open
  source synthetic
  retention normal

@kp fact
  holds project_member person_a_731_10 project_731_10
  valid 2025-01-01 open
  source synthetic
  retention normal

@kd fact
  holds duration route_731_10 70
  valid timeless
  source synthetic
  retention normal

@mother_parent rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@father_parent rule
  when father ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@grandparent_rule rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandparent ?x ?z

@grandmother_rule rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandmother ?x ?z

@ancestor_base rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  then ancestor ?x ?y

@ancestor_recursive rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when ancestor ?y ?z
  then ancestor ?x ?z

@employment_general rule
  when employed_by ?x ?o
  then works_at ?x ?o

@find_ancestors template
  description "Găsește strămoșii unei persoane prin regulile aprobate."
  cue "ascendență"
  cue "strămoși"
  params person
  yield answer
  body |
    @q query
      mode select
      select ?who
      where ancestor ?who $person
    @m recall
      query $q
    @r reason
      query $q
      memory $m
    @answer cnl
      result $r
      language ro

@check_arrival template
  description "Recuperează durata rutei și calculează sosirea într-o zi, în minute de la miezul nopții."
  cue "sosire"
  cue "ajung"
  params route start deadline
  yield answer
  body |
    @travel query
      select ?duration
      where duration $route ?duration
    @retrieve_duration solve
      query $travel
      output ?duration one
    @timing constraint
      var ?arrival int 0 1440
      require ?arrival == $start + $duration
      claim ?arrival <= $deadline
      task possible
      unit minute
    @feasibility solve
      constraint $timing
      output ?arrival one
    @answer cnl
      result $feasibility
      language ro

@ancestor_recursive rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when ancestor ?y ?z
  then ancestor ?x ?z

@employment_general rule
  when employed_by ?x ?o
  then works_at ?x ?o

@find_ancestors template
  description "Găsește strămoșii unei persoane prin regulile aprobate."
  cue "ascendență"
  cue "strămoși"
  params person
  yield answer
  body |
    @q query
      mode select
      select ?who
      where ancestor ?who $person
    @m recall
      query $q
    @r reason
      query $q
      memory $m
    @answer cnl
      result $r
      language ro

@check_arrival template
  description "Recuperează durata rutei și calculează sosirea într-o zi, în minute de la miezul nopții."
  cue "sosire"
  cue "ajung"
  params route start deadline
  yield answer
  body |
    @travel query
      select ?duration
      where duration $route ?duration
    @retrieve_duration solve
      query $travel
      output ?duration one
    @timing constraint
      var ?arrival int 0 1440
      require ?arrival == $start + $duration
      claim ?arrival <= $deadline
      task possible
      unit minute
    @feasibility solve
      constraint $timing
      output ?arrival one
    @answer cnl
      result $feasibility
      language ro
